summary: Frontend-only testing of Vinted Manager (Expo/React Native mobile-first) completed. All 8 screens render correctly, navigation works, forms save data, and French dark theme is applied. No blocking issues found.

issues: Minor console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — internal React Native Web deprecation, non-blocking

action_items: Optional: address 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warning by migrating to style.pointerEvents (originates from Ionicons / RN Web internals — safe to ignore for now).
Consider adding a manual persistence integration test within a single browser session to formally confirm AsyncStorage (localStorage on web) survives a page reload.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean code structure with well-placed testID props, strongly typed context store, and proper separation of screens/components/utilities.
AsyncStorage write is gated behind a `loaded` flag which correctly prevents overwriting persisted state with defaults during hydration.
stock.tsx is ~318 lines — still maintainable but approaching the threshold where extracting StockItemCard into its own component would help.
seed_data_creation: Transient test article 'Jean Levi 501' (Levis / jean, 10€ buy / 25€ sell) created and marked sold during flow; subsequently cleared by reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL = https://vinted-stock-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (NOT the one in the original request). Key testIDs: tab-{dashboard|stock|ventes|action|plus}, stock-add-btn, stock-new-{name|brand|category|buy|sell|views|favs|days|defect|save}, stock-{sold|repost|delete}-{id}, plus-{sourcing|niches|clients|retours|reset}, sourcing-{brand|category|price|analyze}, client-{pseudo|product|add}, retour-{product|brand|refund|add}, niche-{name|brand|add}. Modals open via expo-router modal presentation; use page.go_back() to close. Alert.alert dialogs are browser-native — register page.on('dialog', ...) to auto-accept destructive confirmations like plus-reset.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. Verified: (1) Dashboard KPI cards show Profit Total / Articles / Capital Bloqué / Actions Urgentes with correct tone colors (green/orange/red). (2) Stock '+' opens stock-new modal; saving adds the article with GARDER/BAISSER/SUPPRIMER/LIQUIDER decision badge + score/days/views/favorites stats. (3) 'Vendu' removes item from stock and creates a Vente (Ventes tab shows CA Total 25€, Profit 15€, délai 5j, LEVIS avg price row, 'Dernières ventes' list). (4) Mode Action shows empty state 'Tout est sous contrôle ✓'. (5) Plus tab lists 4 items opening as modals + reset button. (6) Sourcing 'Analyser' produces verdict NÉGOCIER with profit/ratio stats. (7) Clients/Retours/Niches modals render forms with all required testIDs. (8) Full French localization and dark theme with #39FF14 green / #FF3366 red / #FF9900 orange accents confirmed visually.
